author: Saurav Kharel
review_text: Needs Serious Improvement eSewa often lags, sometimes opens by itself, and doesn’t always work when needed. It’s frustrating for a financial app. Nepal may be small, but that’s no excuse — look at Alipay in China: fast, reliable, and trusted by billions. eSewa should be inspired to do better, not settle.
